top_comments.text:
This is so true…I don’t know where to start.  I’m using various tools at work to generate reports, some summaries, email replies etc ….all of which have save me sooooo much time! 
Example, I’m on leave for two weeks, so to give a brief to my team on things that they might be asked while I’m away, seriously took me 10 minutes to delivery the brief. 
Normally would taken hours and evening work….
